title: Mailing Lists
html:
To get support for Kamailio® (SER/OpenSER) specific features or issues, participate in the mailing lists open for public community. If you use Kamailio we would like you to always subscribe to the kamailio-announce mailing list to make sure we can reach you with important information about upgrades.

Important Note: to protect against spammers that subscribe to lists and then quickly within seconds send a spam message, new subscriptions to certain mailing lists may take 10-15 minutes to get approved after the new subscriber email has been confirmed.

  • sr-users @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is dedicated for general purpose discussions about Kamailio (OpenSER) stable releases.
    This is the list to use for all kind or problems, suggestions and ideas. If you don’t get an answer, either your problem is too hard for people to solve or you have not added enough information. Try again with more details and parts of your configuration, maybe some logged error messages from logging and examples. If English is not your first language, you might want to check your message with someone else – maybe other participants just did not understand your issue? Don’t be afraid to post, there are people from all parts of the world on the list and many that have another first language.
    Do not use this list for commercial information, use the business mailing list instead.
  • sr-dev @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is dedicated for development related discussions and extensions or modifications of Kamailio (OpenSER) source code. Anyone who is interested in technical discussions is welcome to subscribe to the list. Please do not cross-post to both mailing lists or use the developer’s mailing list when you do not get an answer in sr-users. The sr-dev mailing list is not a second level support.
  • business @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is dedicated for discussions related to business opportunities and agreements – the basic rules are to use a decent vocabulary and do not to attack other companies or products, focus on promoting yours.
  • sr-users-es @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is dedicated for general purpose discussions in Spanish about (Kamailio (OpenSER) + SIP Express Router (SER)) stable releases (la lista está dedicada a las discusiones en español sobre SIP Router (Kamailio (OpenSER) + SIP Express Router (SER)).
  • sr-docs @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is dedicated for discussions about the Kamailio (OpenSER) documentation, for example the development guide and the getting started document.
  • kamailio-announce @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is dedicated for important announcements related to Kamailio (OpenSER) project, for example: security issues, new releases. Posts are moderated.

Old mailing lists (you can browse the archives):

  • devel @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is closed, replaced by sr-dev@lists.sip-router.org. It was the former mailing list dedicated for discussions related to development version and next steps of Kamailio (OpenSER).
  • users @ lists.kamailio.org – the list is closed, replaced by sr-users@lists.sip-router.org. It was he former list dedicated for general purpose discussions about Kamailio (OpenSER) stable releases.

Please note that only subscribed users can post messages on these mailing lists. This rule is to prevent spams. If you are not subscribed, but want to post messages, please consider subscribing before sending. Bounced messages might be dropped automatically. Do not ask administrators to check bounced messages and let your message pass through. It cost nothing to subscribe or unsubscribe to/from these mailing lists. Thanks for understanding.

Recommended rules:

  • Please observe the Kamailio Code of Conduct if you use this communication channels
  • do not contact developers directly, use mailing lists, others may give the best reply much faster
  • all the time please keep CC-ing to mailing list address, don’t shift to private discussions
  • whenever possible, close the discussion thread with short message saying that provided solution or conclusion is good or wrong, so that the next coming and reading archives knows the result of a discussion

To register bug reports, documentation or support requests or to submit patched, please use the project’s tracker system: Kamailio (OpenSER) tracker
